Addendum.description: A later addition to a published chapter, rendered as its own block.
Addendum.title: Addendum

AliasLookupResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/entities/aliases/lookup`. `entity_id` is null (and
the other keys absent) when no entity of this user owns the alias.
AliasLookupResponse.title: AliasLookupResponse

AnswerCitation.description: One entry cited by a synthesized answer.
AnswerCitation.title: AnswerCitation

AnswerResponse.description:
Body of `POST /api/search/answer`. `answered` is false (with a fixed
message in `answer`) when the journal doesn't cover the question;
`is_question` is false when the query was a plain search, and `answer`
is then empty.
AnswerResponse.title: AnswerResponse

CalendarDay.description: One day with at least one entry.
CalendarDay.title: CalendarDay

CalendarHeatmapResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/calendar-heatmap`.
`from`/`to` echo the query params and are null when omitted.
CalendarHeatmapResponse.title: CalendarHeatmapResponse

ChapterMeta.description:
Chapter metadata: the chapter list on a storyline, and the body of the
read, unread and rename routes. Dates and `entry_count` derive from the
chapter's entries.
ChapterMeta.title: ChapterMeta

CitationSegment.description:
A citation of a quote from an entry
(`journal.services.storylines.segments.citation_segment`). `entry_date`
is absent on narratives stored before the field existed.
CitationSegment.title: CitationSegment

ContentBoundary.description: Half-open `[char_start, char_end)` range in `raw_text` holding the entry's content.
ContentBoundary.title: ContentBoundary

CreateStorylineResponse.description:
Body of `POST /api/storylines` (201). `bootstrap_job_id` is null when
the bootstrap job could not be queued.
CreateStorylineResponse.title: CreateStorylineResponse

Entity.description: A full entity record: detail, update and alias routes.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityDistributionItem.description: Mention count of one entity in the window.
EntityDistributionItem.title: EntityDistributionItem

EntityDistributionResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/entity-distribution`.
`type` echoes the entity-type filter (null when absent).
EntityDistributionResponse.title: EntityDistributionResponse

EntityMention.description: One mention of an entity in an entry.
EntityMention.title: EntityMention

EntityRelationship.description:
One `subject -predicate-> object` edge, with both entities' names and
types and the date of the entry it was extracted from.
EntityRelationship.title: EntityRelationship

EntitySummary.description: An entity in a list, with its mention count.
EntitySummary.title: EntitySummary

EntityTrendBin.description: Mentions of one entity in one period.
EntityTrendBin.title: EntityTrendBin

EntityTrendsResponse.title: EntityTrendsResponse

EntityUpdateResponse.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/entities/{id}`. `reembed_job_id` is present only
when the description changed and a re-embed job was queued.
EntityUpdateResponse.title: EntityUpdateResponse

EntryChunk.description: One persisted chunk; offsets are into `final_text` (end exclusive).
EntryChunk.title: EntryChunk

EntryDetail.description: One entry with its text: `GET /api/entries/{id}` and verify-doubts.
EntryDetail.title: EntryDetail

EntrySummary.description: One row of `GET /api/entries`: an entry without its text.
EntrySummary.title: EntrySummary

EntryUpdateResponse.description:
Body of `PATCH /api/entries/{id}`: the updated entry plus the ids of
any background jobs the edit queued (each key only when queued).
EntryUpdateResponse.title: EntryUpdateResponse

MoodDimension.description:
One mood facet from the server's TOML config. `score_min` and
`score_max` follow from `scale_type` (bipolar `[-1, 1]`, unipolar
`[0, 1]`).
MoodDimension.title: MoodDimension

MoodDimensionsMeta.description:
Metadata of the mood-dimensions config file; empty strings when mood
scoring is off or the file has no `[meta]` block.
MoodDimensionsMeta.title: MoodDimensionsMeta

MoodDimensionsResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/mood-dimensions`. `dimensions` is empty
when mood scoring is disabled.
MoodDimensionsResponse.title: MoodDimensionsResponse

MoodDrilldownEntry.description: One entry's score for the drilled-down dimension.
MoodDrilldownEntry.title: MoodDrilldownEntry

MoodDrilldownResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/mood-drilldown`.
`from` and `to` are required query params, so they are never null here.
MoodDrilldownResponse.title: MoodDrilldownResponse

MoodEntityCorrelationItem.description: Average score of one dimension over the entries mentioning an entity.
MoodEntityCorrelationItem.title: MoodEntityCorrelationItem

MoodEntityCorrelationResponse.title: MoodEntityCorrelationResponse

MoodTrendsResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/mood-trends`.
Buckets with no scored entries are omitted.
MoodTrendsResponse.title: MoodTrendsResponse

PublicHealthResponse.description:
Body of the unauthenticated `GET /health`: liveness only.

The authenticated `GET /api/health` (`api_health_authed`) carries
more blocks and gets its own shape.
PublicHealthResponse.title: PublicHealthResponse

SearchChunkMatch.description:
One chunk that matched the query (`journal.models.ChunkMatch`).
Offsets and index are null for entries ingested before chunks were
persisted.
SearchChunkMatch.title: SearchChunkMatch

SearchResultItem.title: SearchResultItem

StorylineAnchor.description: One anchor entity. `canonical_name` is empty if the entity is gone.
StorylineAnchor.title: StorylineAnchor

StorylineDetail.description:
Body of `GET /api/storylines/{id}`: the summary plus chapter metadata
in `seq` order (the draft last).
StorylineDetail.title: StorylineDetail

StorylineJobResponse.description: Body of the job-queueing storyline routes (refresh, unpublish; 202).
StorylineJobResponse.title: StorylineJobResponse

StorylineSummary.description: A storyline in a list, and the body of `PATCH /api/storylines/{id}`.
StorylineSummary.title: StorylineSummary

TokenSpan.description: One tiktoken token; offsets are into `final_text` (end exclusive).
TokenSpan.title: TokenSpan

UncertainSpan.description: Half-open `[char_start, char_end)` range in `raw_text` the OCR model flagged.
UncertainSpan.title: UncertainSpan

WordCountBucket.description: One histogram bucket of entry word counts.
WordCountBucket.title: WordCountBucket

WordCountStats.description: Summary of entry word counts in the window (zeros when empty).
WordCountStats.title: WordCountStats

WritingFrequencyBin.description:
One non-empty bucket: `asdict(journal.models.WritingFrequencyBin)`.
`bin_start` is the ISO date of the bucket's first day.
WritingFrequencyBin.title: WritingFrequencyBin

WritingStatsResponse.description:
Body of `GET /api/dashboard/writing-stats`.
Empty buckets are omitted.
WritingStatsResponse.title: WritingStatsResponse
